cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.summary: using Observable#mergeWith(CompletableSource), upstream occurs an error, but the ComletableSource won't be disposed

evidence.eventual_fix_title: 3.x: Fix mergeWith not cancelling the other source if the main errors
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
3.x: Fix mergeWith not cancelling the other source if the main errors

The `mergeWith` implementations' `onError` (called by the main source) cancelled the main source instead of cancelling the other source. This mistake affects all 2 x 3 overloads of the operator.

Fixes #6597
